name: Beat the Beast: Griffin's Gold - Reborn
review:
Beat the Beast: Griffin's Gold - Reborn revives the series finale on a 3x5 grid with 9 lines. The bonus game gives free spins with roaming wilds and a soaring wild multiplier.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 22,222x cap and a 96.14% RTP, the biggest ceiling in the Beat the Beast series.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
